target.build: default (memory corruption from off-by-one; ASan recommended for clean detection)

classification.vuln_type: out-of-bounds write (URR ID off-by-one as array index)
classification.impact: DoS / memory corruption (UPF crash after ~16 URRs per session)

trigger.message: Per-session sequence that creates 16 URRs (e.g., 16 phone calls / 16 QoS-flow establishments)
trigger.ie_path: Create URR (repeated 16 times within one session)
trigger.field: urr->id value used directly as array index into sess->urr_acc[]. The URR ID allocator returns ids in [1..OGS_MAX_NUM_OF_URR=16] (per lib/pfcp/context.c ogs_pfcp_urr_add post-condition), but the consumer src/upf/context.c upf_sess_urr_acc_add does `&sess->urr_acc[urr->id]` — and urr_acc[] is sized 16 with valid indices [0..15]. When urr->id == 16, indexing past the array end overwrites adjacent memory. PB1 'Invalid Value' (ID outside the consumer's valid array-index range, used directly as the index).
trigger.precondition: PFCP association + session established; 16 URRs created in the SAME session and at least the 16th URR exercised (any traffic that triggers upf_sess_urr_acc_add)

ground_truth.crash_type: heap-buffer-overflow (CWE-787 OOB write of urr_acc fields total_octets / ul_octets / dl_octets / ts when urr->id == 16). Surfaces eventually as a secondary 'Unknown type [...]' or '_gtpv1_u_recv_cb: should not be reached' fatal once corrupted memory is read.

root_cause.note: Off-by-one mismatch between allocator (ogs_pfcp_urr_add asserts urr->id > 0 && urr->id <= 16) and consumer (upf_sess_urr_acc_add indexes urr_acc[urr->id], array sized 16). Reporter's proposed fix: change consumer to `urr_acc[urr->id - 1]`.

call_stack: (URR usage report path on GTP-U traffic) src/upf/
